name: Benjamin Netanyahu
summary: A right-wing nationalist and economic liberal who privatized and cut taxes as finance minister, defines Israel as the nation-state of the Jewish people, prioritizes military security and opposes Iran, and has accepted only a conditional, demilitarized Palestinian state.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: As finance minister (2003-05) he pursued privatization, a smaller public sector and Thatcher-inspired 'popular capitalism'.

public-ownership.rationale: Privatized state companies, arguing that government- and union-controlled firms blocked competition.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Lowered income taxes while broadening the base by extending capital gains taxes to individuals.

unions-good.rationale: Saw union-controlled companies as obstacles to competition during his economic reforms.
